sources.content:
What's the main purpose of the Prompt Test Harness mini project?
To make prompts run faster ·  1.
To systematically and repeatably evaluate prompt reliability and compare versions, rather than relying on ad hoc testing ·  1.
To replace the need for Pydantic ·  1.
To generate prompts automatically without human input ·  1.
Answer: b
20. Why is 'the model got it right once' insufficient evidence that a prompt is production-ready?
It's actually sufficient evidence ·  1.
A single success doesn't demonstrate reliability across the range of real, varied production inputs ·  1.
Models never succeed more than once ·  1.
Production inputs are always identical to test inputs ·  1.
Answer: b
Practical Test
Design Challenge: Design a prompt (all seven components as needed) for a task that extracts structured meeting action items (assignee, task, due date) from a raw transcript, including handling the case where a due date isn't mentioned.
Debugging Exercise: A structured-output prompt worked reliably in testing but started failing validation in production for a subset of inputs. List the most likely causes (hint: think about input length/truncation, edge cases not covered in your golden set, and prompt-injection-adjacent content in real user input) and how you'd diagnose which one is occurring.
Scenario-Based Question: Your team wants to switch a production feature's underlying model from Provider A to Provider B to reduce cost. What's your process for validating the prompt still performs reliably on the new provider before shipping the switch?
Interview Questions
Beginner
What's the difference between a system prompt and a user prompt? 1.
What is few-shot prompting? 2.
What is chain-of-thought prompting, and when is it useful? 3.
What does it mean for a prompt to be 'constrained'? 4.
Why might you ask a model to return JSON instead of free-form text? 5.
Intermediate
How would you design a prompt to reliably produce schema-conformant JSON? 1.
What's your process for testing a prompt change before deploying it to production? 2.
What is prompt injection, and why is it a real security concern, not just a theoretical one? 3.
How do you decide when a task needs few-shot examples versus zero-shot instructions alone?

executive_summary.title: Executive Summary
executive_summary.content: A polyphase system is a means of distributing alternating-current electrical power that utilizes more than one AC phase [cite_1]. These electrical distribution networks enable modern grids to operate efficiently on a massive scale [cite_2]. Initial European development spawned interest in alternating-current electrical power produced from two-phase systems and eventually three-phase or polyphase systems [cite_3]. Furthermore, three-phase power is commonly used to run large induction motors and heavy industrial loads [cite_4].

sections.title: Evolution of Polyphase Systems
sections.content: The term polyphase system was coined by Silvanus Thompson to describe systems utilizing more than one AC phase offset in degrees [cite_5]. Historical developments in electric power transmission date back to the late 19th century [cite_6]. Nikola Tesla's contributions to alternating current and polyphase systems allowed electrical grids to scale efficiently [cite_7].

sections.title: Single-Circuit and Single-Phase Motor Architectures
sections.content: In single-phase induction motors, an auxiliary winding can be disconnected once the motor gains speed, since a pulsating magnetic field of a single phase can sustain operation [cite_8]. Smaller devices and household equipment rely on single-phase circuits derived from larger power networks [cite_9].

claims.text: In single-phase motors, the auxiliary winding can be disconnected after gaining speed because a single-phase pulsating magnetic field can run the motor.

conclusion.title: Conclusion
conclusion.content: The transition from early alternating-current setups to comprehensive polyphase networks revolutionized electrical engineering [cite_10]. Understanding these foundational electrical topologies and motor configurations remains essential for efficient power transmission and industrial machine design [cite_11].
